title: What a canvas may not see
blurb: Permission buttons, visited links, spelling markers, autofill and content from other origins, each placed in a drawable canvas: is it in the picture, can script read it, and does it still work.
question: What does the browser do with protected content, such as permission buttons, visited links and cross-origin frames, when a canvas draws it?
result: Cross-origin content is left out of the picture and the canvas is never tainted. Permission elements are drawn and stop working. Links are drawn as unvisited.
